value.name: Asha enters with unresolved message thread
value.description: Asha comes inside still carrying the unresolved thread about Devin, aware she must address it soon.
evidence: Devin's name still presumably at the top of the thread she had not reopened since the kitchen.
whatever she said to him tonight she would have to say in the next hour

value.name: Asha checks the phone thread
value.description: Inside, Asha sets down her briefcase and opens the phone thread to review Devin's messages.
evidence: Inside, Asha set the briefcase on the kitchen table without taking off her coat and lifted the phone out of the outside pocket.
The thread was where she had left it, Devin's name at the top, three unanswered messages stacked beneath the one she had opened from the car on Wednesday.

value.name: Asha rereads Devin's messages
value.description: She scrolls back through the conversation and rereads the full exchange, including his offer to sign and the later filing update.
evidence: She scrolled to the beginning and read all of it this time, the Tuesday afternoon I can sign this if you want and her own delayed go ahead, then the line that came later, Filed at 4:51, signature block attached, and the photo of the page with his name where hers should have been.
She read it twice, then a third time, slower

value.name: Asha realizes Devin filed the document
value.description: As she rereads the timestamps, Asha understands that Devin acted on her instruction and filed the document with his signature in her place.
evidence: until the order of the messages stopped rearranging itself in her head and what remained was the simple fact of the timestamps and the boy who had taken her at her word.

value.name: Asha sets phone aside and removes coat
value.description: She puts the phone face-down, takes off her coat, and leaves it draped over a chair instead of hanging it up.
evidence: Asha turned the phone face-down on the table and finally shrugged out of her coat, draping it over the back of the chair instead of hanging it up.

value.name: Asha begins drafting a correction
value.description: Asha takes out a legal pad and starts writing the formal correction she will need to submit.
evidence: She pulled a legal pad from the briefcase and uncapped a pen, and began writing out the correction in the spare, formal phrasing she would need on the page itself
